qa_pairs.question: What do I need to open an account?
qa_pairs.answer:
We offer individual brokerage accounts for a variety of clients, including:
U.S. Persons
: Individuals who are U.S. citizens or residents and meet the identification and documentation requirements. Applicants need to be at least 18 years old, have a valid Social Security number (not a Taxpayer Identification Number), and proof of U.S. residential address (such as a utility bill or bank statement).
n-U.S. Persons
: Individuals who reside outside the U.S. and meet applicable regulatory, tax, and documentation requirements. Applicants need to be at least 18 years old and must provide a copy of Government-issued photo identification in the initial onboarding.
Please note that additional information may be required during the account review process, such as a copy of photo ID, Proof of Address, or Tax ID proof.
As of June 12, 2025, to comply with the latest regulatory guidelines, we are currently upgrading account opening access for Mainland Chinese and Taiwanese users. During this period, these users will be temporarily unable to open TradeUP accounts.
Welcome to TradeUP!

qa_pairs.question: How long does it take for the account to get approved?
qa_pairs.answer:
Once the application is successfully submitted, it normally takes about 1-2 business days for the new account team to review and approve your account.
If additional information is needed, you will receive an email notification from TradeUP requesting further response. You may upload the required documents (Photo ID or Proof of address) directly through the TradeUP platform.
Please closely monitor your email inbox (including your Spam/Junk folder) to ensure you don’t miss any communication.
We surely appreciate your patience!

qa_pairs.question: What is a Trusted Contact Person?
qa_pairs.answer:
On February 5, 2018, FINRA enacted a new rule to help protect investors from financial exploitation and fraud. This rule requires all brokerage firms to ask their retail customers to provide the name and contact information for a “trusted contact person” the firm may contact in the event of possible financial exploitation or fraud.
trusted contact person
” is a person that you authorize your brokerage firm to contact if your broker has a reasonable belief that your account may be exposed to possible financial exploitation or fraud. A trusted contact person must be age 18 or older.
For more information, please see:
https://www.investor.gov/introduction-investing/general-resources/news-alerts/alerts-bulletins/investor-bulletins-30

qa_pairs.question: How do I close my TradeUP Securities account?
qa_pairs.answer:
We're very sorry to hear that you're leaving. Before we can process your account closure request, here are a few tips we would like to share with you:
Prior to submitting your account closure request:
Please make sure you have either withdrawn or transferred all funds from your account.
Please do not make any more deposits to your account.
Once the request has been submitted successfully, your account will be processed to close within 7 business days.
Account Statements:
You will still be able to retrieve your account statements, trade confirmations, and tax documents through your app or by requesting them from our customer service team after your account is closed.
Recordkeeping Requirements:
Per regulatory requirements, we will preserve certain records after the account is closed. All your account information and data will be securely guarded with us solely to fulfill this requirement.
